findings.kind: conditional presentation policy and source-derived correctness concern
findings.title: Simplification before clipping can erase an entire short boundary crossing
findings.static_reasoning: At equatorial origin, Neighborhood scale has 30 m spacing, 960 m half-window and 3 m simplification tolerance. A hypothetical admitted polyline with E7 (longitude, latitude) coordinates [(-86300,-300),(-86100,0),(-86300,300)] has local east offsets -960.6916,-958.4652,-960.6916 m and north offsets -3.3396,0,3.3396 m. Its bounding rectangle intersects the window, and its center vertex lies inside. The center is 2.2264 m from the chord joining outside endpoints, so simplification drops it; the resulting chord is wholly west of the window, and clipping yields no connection.
findings.conditions: Assume matching final terrain/source and geometry/content digest for an admitted package covering these geographic points. The contract currently describes physical presentation error, not an explicit requirement to retain every sub-cell boundary crossing; need a policy decision before calling it a defect. Source routing and source digest are not modified.
findings.future_direction: Decide whether sub-tolerance boundary crossings must be preserved; if so, design boundary-aware approximation or clip before simplifying, preserving connected piece and point-cap policies, and later validate under authorized product work.
relationships: 059 queue Q-L12-89cc9e903cae772dd0fc / q1866 concerns related regional environment and geometry contracts; no alias or closure asserted.
Adler 059 L11-381 recognized intended simplify-before-clip display tolerance; this mathematical case refines the later presentation-policy question.

findings.kind: conditional source identity and authority question
findings.title: Terrain-linked road geometry digest omits displayed connection classification
findings.static_reasoning: The terrain-matched geometry digest is serialized from line point arrays alone. Binary decoding reads a valid kind tag into each line, and capture retains that kind in the returned RegionalConnection. The payload hash covers the tag but is declared by the road manifest itself, while manifest source and geometry are compared with terrain. Thus two hypothetical coherent package/manifest pairs with identical terrain-linked coordinates and source identity but distinct valid kind tags can each meet their own declared content digest and yield different presentation classification.
findings.conditions: This is a semantic identity gap only if classification must be determined by the same authoritative source identity; it may be intentionally independently mutable presentation data. Assumes separately matching valid content hashes and terrain, and says nothing about malicious modification, existing artifacts, or cryptographic breakage. No binary, hash, or package was generated or executed.
findings.future_direction: Determine the authority and immutability contract for kind; if bound to the source, incorporate classification in the authoritative identity and coordinate future producer/consumer acceptance as one connected repair, with no compatibility shims.
relationships: 059 q1866 regional data/source contract; q1644 Q-L12-370b4d9e2db93added14 stage-content provenance; q279 SEGOVB-L12-TERRAIN-SOURCE-DIGEST-PROPAGATION: related, identity/alias unresolved.

findings.title: Selected source line can require quadratic simplification work before output bounds
findings.static_reasoning: Admission caps the whole package at 1,000,000 source points and 50,000 lines but imposes no smaller per-line cap. Every intersecting line is completely projected and simplified before clipping and before the regional output point cap. The iterative simplifier scans each retained interval; if repeated farthest-point splits are near an end, its comparison count can grow quadratically in the line size. Two capture permits cap concurrent captures, not cost per selected line.
findings.conditions: Worst-case conditional source-level complexity only; actual available road geometry, chosen viewport, split pattern, latency, and operational work budget have not been examined or measured. No fixtures, product execution or timing were used.
findings.future_direction: Establish source-shape and interactive work budget. If required, design bounded simplification or preprocessed spatial segmentation while preserving source identity, clipping continuity and accepted presentation error; validate only after the explicit stop is lifted.
relationships: Adler 059 READ-L11-381 specifically left package point caps and worst-case simplifier work unresolved; this connects the personally inspected 95e package bound to that question without declaring a new historical alias.
059 q1866 concerns regional source/capacity contracts; related, not an asserted alias.

nonfindings.text: Regional rectangles explicitly exclude antimeridian-crossing bounds; clamping by itself does not prove an accidental wrap defect.
Native continuous projection permits intermediates outside WGS84 or source bounds, with coverage handled by terrain lookup; no out-of-bounds defect inferred from this design alone.

RegionalConnection admits at least two distinct positions and removes consecutive duplicates; RegionalEnvironment checks aggregate point and line caps using checked addition. WindowOutput is local and discarded after an error, so its increment before Err does not establish corrupt retained state.
Lazy road load retains an empty slot on admission failure for retry; a resident package with mismatched source is rejected, and poison is a typed ownership error.
The HTTP capture has typed source and scale, coordinate admission, semaphore try-acquire and explicit no-store while sampling revision is absent; no cache or unbounded queued-task finding inferred.

The city route checks a selected existing authenticated character and settlement variant; profile reads operators and names. Neither this nor the environment route lacking a Session extractor proves missing authorization without the product knowledge and disclosure policy.
The simplifier uses an explicit work stack, preserving endpoints; no recursion-stack overflow is asserted.
